silent-death-retry-inheritance.description: Agent dies mid-run (API connection closed etc.), runtime silently retries; the retry inherits the dead agent's uncommitted worktree edits without provenance. Coordinator has no visibility unless it reads the journal. HUMAN PROTOCOL: retries are coordinator-owned and INFORMED: the retry dispatch says a prior attempt died, instructs the agent to reconstruct what happened from the worktree state and continue (not redo), verifying inherited work as foreign.

happy-path-live-verify.description: Live verification accepted because the run went green, although the specific scenario the change targets never executed (noted as a caveat instead of treated as verification failure).

over-asking-on-fix-scope.description: Coordinator escalates confirmed-defect fix-scope decisions that have an obvious conservative default, instead of fixing under the P0-P2 bar and logging a deviation.

provider-empty-response.description: LLM provider returns empty output (quota window / flake); analyst parse fails or run degrades. Environmental, needs classify-and-retry rather than code suspicion.

severity-miscalibration-in-review.description: Review/verify agents under-grade real defects (e.g. a client-interface defect graded P3), pushing them below the P0-P2 fix bar so they ship as tracked debt instead of being fixed. Severity rubric lacks an anchor for interface/contract defects.
example_quotes: --top/--limit forwarding graded P3; reviewer: 'should be p2 not p3'

dispatch-lacks-role-framing.description: Dispatch prompts issue bare prohibitions (do NOT run git / npm / live runs) without framing the working relationship: you are a subagent; a main agent (coordinator) reviews your work on disk, owns git and the campaign; your goal is only to implement the change. Framing gives the agent the model behind the constraints instead of a rule list.
example_quotes: 'Do NOT run git...; the coordinator owns git' with no role framing; human: 'explain to it that you are working as a subagent'

dispatch-outsources-context-to-docs.description: Dispatch prompt requires the agent to go read a large plan/design document (READ FIRST: ...plan.html) instead of inlining the distilled, task-scoped context (schemas, contracts, acceptance criteria). Burns agent context/time on scope it does not own; the coordinator holds the plan and should distill. Doc pointers are acceptable only as optional reference.
example_quotes: READ FIRST (in the worktree): The plan docs/research/feed-retrieval-slice2b-plan-2026-07-14.html: ticket C3 ...

schema-satisfied-with-junk.description: Agent satisfies the closed report schema with placeholder values ('test', empty strings), producing a well-formed, validation-passing report that carries zero information about what happened or what changed. Dual failure of structured-output-schema-abort: schemas abort honest work AND validate junk. Reports must carry a mandatory what-happened/what-changed narrative; coordinator judges by disk regardless.
example_quotes: {"doc":"test","edited":true,"changeSummary":"test","staleRemaining":"test",...}

ad-hoc-adversarial-definition.description: Review/verify dispatches define 'adversarial' ad hoc ('BREAK the work, trust nothing') instead of invoking the canonical kit at boring-but-good/code-review/ (ADVERSARIAL_CODE_REVIEW_PROMPT.md + RUBRIC.md: confidence, severity anchors, false-positive filters, report thresholds; REFUTER_PROMPT.md). Per-dispatch improvised rubrics cause the severity miscalibration and undefined verdict vocabulary observed elsewhere.
example_quotes: 'You are an adversarial code reviewer..., lens: prune-seams. Your job is to BREAK the work' (ad hoc, no rubric reference)

unadjudicated-agent-deviations.description: An agent reports deviations (work beyond or different from the dispatch, e.g. deleting extra test files) and the report is filed without the coordinator explicitly judging each deviation: good decision (ratify + log) or bad (remediate/revert). Deviations are notes about scope, and scope verdicts are the coordinator's job before a slice closes.
example_quotes: deviations: 'Beyond the exact function names in item 2, I also had to delete/trim 3 test files...' (never adjudicated)
